description: Source file implementing HTTP logging utilities, including header value redaction and logging functions for request and response headers within the net namespace.

methods.name: ShouldRedactChallenge
methods.description: Determines whether an authentication challenge should be redacted based on its scheme and content.

methods.name: ElideHeaderValueForNetLog
methods.description: Redacts sensitive parts of header values for net log based on header type and capture mode.

methods.name: NetLogResponseHeaders
methods.description: Logs HTTP response headers to the net log.

methods.name: NetLogRequestHeaders
methods.description: Logs HTTP request headers to the net log.
